states.revealedText:
Our scouts report that the Hollow Men have raided South America. We quickly mobilized... but too late.

Open Package 5 and follow the instructions inside. (This does not complete any objectives.)

Destroy the "Strategic Reserves" Unrationed Event card inside.

mechanics.whenRead: STOP. Draw and read during step 2 of the setup of the first game in April. This is the card the March game-end reading stops on.
triggers: 67 (South America) has not been opened: scratch the box.
destroys: The "Strategic Reserves" Unrationed Event inside Package 5, if the box is scratched.
rules: If 67 is already open, scratch nothing.
If 67 is sealed, open Package 5 and follow the instructions inside.
Opening Package 5 this way does not complete any objectives.
Destroy the Unrationed Event named Strategic Reserves that is inside the package.
Destroy this card after resolving it.
mechanics.notes: In the revealed box, "Open Package 5" and "Destroy the "Strategic Reserves" Unrationed Event card inside." are bold. Side A is unchanged in state 2.
